questions.q: What two things in the forest does Yahweh compare?
questions.a: Yahweh compares the vine to any tree with branches.

questions.q: What did the Lord Yahweh say he had given the vine for?
questions.a: The Lord Yahweh said he had given the vine as fuel for fires.

questions.q: How does Yahweh say the inhabitants of Jerusalem are like the vine?
questions.a: Yahweh says the inhabitants of Jerusalem are like the vine in that both are given as fuel for fires.

questions.q: What will all know when Yahweh destroys the inhabitants of Jerusalem with fire?
questions.a: All will know that the Lord is Yahweh.

questions.q: Why will Yahweh make the land into an abandoned wasteland?
questions.a: Yahweh will make the land into an abandoned wasteland because the inhabitants of Jerusalem have committed sin.

commentary.text: If a vine be fruitful, it is valuable. But if not fruitful, it is worthless and useless, it is cast into the fire. Thus man is capable of yielding a precious fruit, in living to God; this is the sole end of his existence; and if he fails in this, he is of no use but to be destroyed. What blindness then attaches to those who live in the total neglect of God and of true religion! This similitude is applied to Jerusalem. Let us beware of an unfruitful profession. Let us come to Christ, and seek to abide in him, and to have his words abide in us.
